query:
UPDATE buildsteps SET
              busy = 0,
              status = $1,
              errorMsg = $4,
              startTime = $5,
              stopTime = $6,
              machine = $7,
              overhead = $8,
              timesBuilt = $9,
              isNonDeterministic = $10
            WHERE
              drvPath = $2 AND attempt = $3
